title: The effect of consecutive steps of refining on squalene content of vegetable oils
journal: Journal of Food Science and Technology
population: Olive, sunflower, rapeseed, corn and soybean oils sampled at each refining step in four commercial refineries; 10 olive oil samples
funder: This study was supported financially by the Scientific Research Fund of Celal Bayar University under project number Müh.2007/037.
result: Squalene in olive oil (n = 10): 491.0 mg/100 g in crude oil, reported in the abstract as virgin olive oil; 427.0 after neutralisation (13.0% loss), 392.5 after bleaching (7.0%), 315.5 after deodorisation (15.6%) and 290.0 after winterisation (5.2%); total reduction 40.94%. Crude seed oils contained 13.8 to 26.2 mg/100 g. Crude vegetable oils cannot be consumed without refining, except good-quality virgin olive oil.
